command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
Write-Output '--- QUERY-GPU ---'
& nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,uuid,name,pci.bus_id,compute_mode,persistence_mode,display_active,display_mode,driver_version,vbios_version,pcie.link.gen.current,pcie.link.gen.max,pcie.link.width.current,pcie.link.width.max,memory.total,memory.used,memory.free,memory.reserved,temperature.gpu,temperature.memory,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,power.draw,power.limit,power.default_limit,power.min_limit,power.max_limit,enforced.power.limit,ecc.mode.current,ecc.mode.pending,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,clocks_throttle_reasons.active,fan.speed --format=csv,noheader
Write-Output '--- BAR1 ---'
& nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY
Write-Output '--- ECC ---'
& nvidia-smi -q -d ECC
Write-Output '--- TEMPERATURE-THRESHOLDS ---'
& nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE
Write-Output '--- POWER ---'
& nvidia-smi -q -d POWER
Write-Output '--- COMPUTE-APPS ---'
& nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=gpu_uuid,pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv,noheader
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
Write-Output "LASTEXITCODE=$LASTEXITCODE"
